clips.title: The story
paras: Earthseer Farsen directs the final stage of an investigation into Dark Iron infiltrators beneath Ironforge. You enter the Hall of Thanes under Old Ironforge to confront the threat and report to King Magni Bronzebeard.

After an underground map reveals Dark Iron movements, Earthseer Farsen identifies the mastermind behind the intrusion. The entrance to the Hall of Thanes lies deep within Old Ironforge's ancient stone halls. While the upper city attends to matters above, forces have slipped into the dormant caverns beneath the kingdom.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Gather some allies and head down into the caverns beneath Old Ironforge. Enter the Hall of Thanes there and push to the lower vaults.
My Dark Iron is a bit rusty, but I can make out a name--one Durgen Dirgehammer. It's likely that he's the commander. Take his head and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard.
Oh, and when you do, tell him his old friend Farsen sends his regards!

clips.title: Completion
paras: A Dark Iron incursion--right beneath our feet? Well, I'm relieved to hear that the Dark Iron commander has been dispatched.
The guards will head in and clean up the rest of the rabble. We'll see to it that the breaches are sealed and the lower levels reinforced to ensure that no further incursions are possible.
Thank ye for yer service to Ironforge, adventurer. Take this as a small token of my gratitude. Oh, and if ye see that old Wildhammer rockhugger Farsen again, tell 'em to pay me a proper visit.
